final_metamodel:
# Primary 'Course' class with attributes and references only

create class Course

create attribute courseCode in Course type String
create attribute title in Course type String
create attribute description in Course type String
create attribute credits in Course type int

create reference modules in Course type Module [0..*]
create reference instructor in Course type Instructor [0..1]

# Define primary 'Module' class with its attributes and references

create class Module

create attribute moduleCode in Module type String
create attribute name in Module type String
create attribute durationWeeks in Module type int

create reference course in Module type Course [1..1]

# Define the primary 'Lesson' class with attributes and references, referencing existing classes only

create class Lesson

create attribute lessonTitle in Lesson type String
create attribute lessonNumber in Lesson type int
create attribute durationMinutes in Lesson type int
create attribute lessonDate in Lesson type Date

create reference module in Lesson type Module [1..1]

# Define the primary 'Instructor' class and its direct attributes/references only
create class Instructor

create attribute instructorId in Instructor type String
create attribute firstName in Instructor type String
create attribute lastName in Instructor type String
create attribute email in Instructor type String
create attribute hireDate in Instructor type Date

create reference courses in Instructor type Course [0..*]

# Define primary 'Grade' class with attributes and references only

create class Grade

create attribute value in Grade type String
create attribute dateRecorded in Grade type Date

create reference course in Grade type Course [1..1]
create reference module in Grade type Module [0..1]
create reference lesson in Grade type Lesson [0..1]
create reference instructor in Grade type Instructor [0..1]

# Define the primary 'Student' class and its direct attributes/references only

create class Student

create attribute studentId in Student type String
create attribute firstName in Student type String
create attribute lastName in Student type String
create attribute email in Student type String
create attribute enrollmentDate in Student type Date

# Reference existing classes but do not define them
create reference courses in Student type Course [0..*]
final_sample_model:
# Create primary Course instance
create object Course course1
# Set basic attributes for course1
set courseCode of course1 to "CS101"
set title of course1 to "Introduction to Computer Science"
set description of course1 to "Basics of computer science principles and programming."
set credits of course1 to 4

# Create primary Module instance
create object Module module1
# Set basic attributes for module1
set moduleCode of module1 to "M101"
set name of module1 to "Programming Fundamentals"
set durationWeeks of module1 to 6
# Link module1 to existing course1 (from previous sample)
set course of module1 to course1
# Link course1 to include module1 in modules reference
add module1 to modules of course1

# Create primary Lesson instance to test Lesson metamodel class
create object Lesson lesson1
# Set basic attributes for lesson1
set lessonTitle of lesson1 to "Introduction to Variables"
set lessonNumber of lesson1 to 1
set durationMinutes of lesson1 to 45
set lessonDate of lesson1 to 2024-05-15
# Link lesson1 to existing module1 (from previous sample)
set module of lesson1 to module1
add lesson1 to lessons of module1

# Create primary Instructor instance to test Instructor metamodel class
create object Instructor instructor1
# Set basic attributes for instructor1
set instructorId of instructor1 to "INS1001"
set firstName of instructor1 to "Alice"
set lastName of instructor1 to "Smith"
set email of instructor1 to "alice.smith@example.edu"
set hireDate of instructor1 to 2020-08-01
# Link instructor1 to existing course1 created previously
add course1 to courses of instructor1
set instructor of course1 to instructor1

# Create primary Grade instance to test the Grade metamodel class
create object Grade grade1
# Set basic attributes for grade1
set value of grade1 to "A"
set dateRecorded of grade1 to 2024-06-01
# Link grade1 to existing course1 and module1 from previous sample
set course of grade1 to course1
set module of grade1 to module1
# Link grade1 to existing lesson1 and instructor1 from previous sample
set lesson of grade1 to lesson1
set instructor of grade1 to instructor1

# Create primary Student instance to test the Student metamodel class
create object Student student1
# Set basic attributes for student1
set studentId of student1 to "STU2001"
set firstName of student1 to "John"
set lastName of student1 to "Doe"
set email of student1 to "john.doe@example.edu"
set enrollmentDate of student1 to 2023-09-01
# Link student1 to an existing Course instance from previous sample
add course1 to courses of student1
